newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 130bln lire of Italy 30-yr Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 130bln lire of Italy 30-yr Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 130 billion lire of 30-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 2.877 trillion lire at the open auction for the November 1, 2026 paper, against 1.5 trillion lire worth of paper on offer.
The auction price was set at 93.70 from 95.90 at the previous Btp auction on February 13.
Specialists also bid for 196 billion lire of 10-year Btps against the Treasury's offer of 200 billion.

At the open auction earlier the Treasury received bids for 3.586 trillion lire of the February 1, 2007 paper against 2.0 trillion on offer. The auction price was set at 97.50 against 98.60 at the previous open auction on February 13.
